package main

import (
	"io"
	"os"
	"sort"
	"strings"
	"testing"

	"github.com/spf13/cobra"
)

// Used only through go test -overlay to freeze the starting tree's command
// registry, including factory registrations and Cobra's injected commands.
func TestA7HelpInventory(t *testing.T) {
	rootCmd.SetOut(io.Discard)
	rootCmd.SetErr(io.Discard)
	rootCmd.SetArgs([]string{"--help"})
	if _, err := rootCmd.ExecuteC(); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	var paths []string
	var walk func(*cobra.Command, string)
	walk = func(parent *cobra.Command, prefix string) {
		for _, cmd := range parent.Commands() {
			path := strings.TrimSpace(prefix + " " + cmd.Name())
			paths = append(paths, path)
			walk(cmd, path)
		}
	}
	walk(rootCmd, "")
	sort.Strings(paths)
	if err := os.WriteFile(os.Getenv("A7_HELP_INVENTORY_OUTPUT"), []byte(strings.Join(paths, "\n")+"\n"), 0o644); err != nil {
		t.Fatal("write help inventory")
	}
}
